meta.title: Daybreak Overture - Sangoma's Message
meta.description: I used up all my luck meeting you again, so ever since, each day we spent together has been a miracle.

units.rawText: ...Mm, I can tell just from the look in your eyes. I've missed you too, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: ...Mm, I can tell just from the look in your eyes. I've missed you too, {교수}.

spans.text: ...Mm, I can tell just from the look in your eyes. I've missed you too,

units.rawText: It's nothing short of a miracle to be able to see you again in Magrasea.
units.displayText: It's nothing short of a miracle to be able to see you again in Magrasea.

spans.text: It's nothing short of a miracle to be able to see you again in Magrasea.

units.rawText: Whether it's the brand-new servers, or the network that you can access as you please... This is a future both me and Boss never imagined possible.
units.displayText: Whether it's the brand-new servers, or the network that you can access as you please... This is a future both me and Boss never imagined possible.

spans.text: Whether it's the brand-new servers, or the network that you can access as you please... This is a future both me and Boss never imagined possible.

units.rawText: The difference, however, is that this miracle has been realized by everyone's efforts and wishes.
units.displayText: The difference, however, is that this miracle has been realized by everyone's efforts and wishes.

spans.text: The difference, however, is that this miracle has been realized by everyone's efforts and wishes.

units.rawText: Ahh~ This old frame of mine's about to fall apart with how long I've waited~
units.displayText: Ahh~ This old frame of mine's about to fall apart with how long I've waited~

spans.text: Ahh~ This old frame of mine's about to fall apart with how long I've waited~

units.rawText: At a moment as important as this, won't you partake in a little respite with me?
units.displayText: At a moment as important as this, won't you partake in a little respite with me?

spans.text: At a moment as important as this, won't you partake in a little respite with me?

units.rawText: The night is yet young... We have plenty of time, and I'm sure there's no lack of sentiments between us to share.
